name: Road Traffic Accident Observatory
description: A web platform designed to manage, digitize, and analyze road traffic accident data. The system centralizes accident records, enables advanced data exploration, and provides reporting and visualization tools to support decision-making processes.
highlights: Administrative dashboard for record and report management
Interactive charts and statistical data visualization
Export functionality for Excel and PDF reports

name: Minimum Cost Calculator
description: A web application built to calculate and analyze minimum costs through an intuitive and responsive interface. It provides real-time results, helping users make informed decisions efficiently.
highlights: Responsive design for desktop and mobile devices
